trust.heading: Why Clients Trust GST
trust.card1.title: Independent, vendor-neutral guidance
trust.card1.body: No technology bias, no vendor relationships, no hidden agendas. GST's recommendations are grounded in your strategic objectives and technical realities, not product portfolio incentives.
trust.card2.title: Technical depth, business clarity
trust.card2.body: GST bridges the gap between technical architecture and business impact. Complex systems become clear. Trade-offs get quantified. Risk becomes actionable.
trust.card3.title: Executive-ready outputs
trust.card3.body: Technical findings translated for boards and C-suite. No jargon. Clear implications. Decision-ready context that informs strategy and allocation.
trust.card4.title: Shovel-ready initiatives
trust.card4.body: Every recommendation accounts for budget, timeline, and team capacity. Roadmaps that actually happen. Next steps teams can execute.
